PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-025.text: Cached or precomputed trie roots must match freshly computed roots for the same trie state.

PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-026.text: After Osaka fork activation, trie encoding must use Osaka rules; pre-Osaka encoding must not be applied.
PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-026.assertion: forall block b: b.fork == Osaka => trie_encode(b) uses osaka_trie.encode_node

PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-027.text: Patricialize must produce correct ExtensionNode when all keys share a common prefix of length > 0.
PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-027.assertion: forall obj: shared_prefix(obj, level) > 0 => isinstance(patricialize(obj, level), ExtensionNode)

PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-028.text: BranchNode must have exactly 16 subnodes; missing or extra subnodes indicate structural corruption.

PROP-9ffb0e64-pre-002.text: Before root() computation, _prepare_trie must complete without assertion errors for all entries.
PROP-9ffb0e64-pre-002.assertion: forall trie t: _prepare_trie(t, get_storage_root) completes without AssertionError

PROP-9ffb0e64-post-004.text: After fork transition, derived trie caches from previous fork must be invalidated before new operations.
PROP-9ffb0e64-post-004.assertion: forall fork_transition(old, new): trie_cache(old).invalidated == true before trie_op(new)

PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-029.text: Cached trie root hash must be used for lookups; recomputation may return stale value.
PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-029.assertion: forall trie: trie.cached_root != None => root_hash(trie) == trie.cached_root, not recompute(trie._data)
